description: This file defines a React functional component 'AppStudio' that uses the 'remotion' library to create a composition for an interactive notes and videos application UI within Remotion Studio. It imports React, remotion components, and another local component 'App', and encapsulates the composition setup for development preview.

methods.name: AppStudio
methods.description: React functional component that sets up a Remotion composition named 'NotesApp' with specific dimensions, frame rate, duration, and the 'App' component as its content.
